messages:
billing-bot: Invoice INV-64200 posted for Atlas Data — total $18,405.22. Link: https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-64200

paul (Customer Success): Atlas says we applied a retroactive rate increase from the pricing experiment; they got charged old invoice + retro adj for Oct usage. They expected new rate only prospectively.

maria (Finance): Our pricing engine applied retro adj because contract had auto-opt clause. Do we have signed notice to customer?

leah (Sales): No notice — I didn't surface auto-opt to them. We discussed opt-in in the Q1 notes but didn't send formal notice. Customer didn't accept retro change.

jude (Billing Ops): System grabbed migration timestamp and computed retro adj 2025-03-01 -> 2025-03-31 for 14M tokens -> adj $3,500. Invoice shows line 'retro rate adjustment $3,500'.

maria (Finance): For disputed retros >$2k need Finance Lead approval. Recommend one-time reversal of retro $3,500 as goodwill; mark as "sales communication miss" and create CM.

cory (Finance Lead): Approve reversal of $3,500 contingent on Sales commit to notify customers and to avoid same billing pattern. GL: 4112; journal CRD-ATLAS-20250315. Also file a compliance note.

leah (Sales): I'll send the formal notice to Atlas and add CRM entry. Apologies — we'll handle outreach.

jude (Billing Ops): Creating credit memo CM-8532 for $3,500 and reissuing INV-64200 -> INV-64200-R; tagging reason: 'retro rate reversal - sales communication miss'.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-8532 created for INV-64200-R amount $3,500.00 (status: pending).

maria (Finance): Please attach the Sales commitment and set CM to 'one-time goodwill' so not picked up by automated policy.

cory (Finance Lead): Thanks. Also open a ticket to modify the pricing engine so retro-adj requires explicit signed acknowledgement or a notification flag before applying.

leah (Sales): On it. Notifying Atlas now and will share the sent note in CS ticket.
